sources.verified: Latest official API still returns v2.6.0.

sources.finding: Standalone ETW console collector supports process PID/name filters, timed recording, frame-type tracking, CSV and no-input options.
track_etw_status is accepted in hidden options even though release --help omits it. No generic --debug option. Do not confuse set_circular_buffer_size with a guessed set_buffer_size.

Status lines report events/buffers/overflow counts without --debug; final warnings report nonzero losses. Optional administrator restart is opt-in. Standard privilege warning describes other-account/short-running process name querying.
Explicit PID target matches independently of process name. Lost/failed presents can be discarded before CSV output. Lack of malformed rows does not prove zero losses.

Corrected using CLI and real foreground smoke: CommandLine.cpp selects MilliSeconds; v2_metrics CPUStartTime is milliseconds and interval FrameTime. Default CLI headers are TimeInMs/CPUStartTimeInMs with MsBetweenAppStart. The writer's seconds switch branch is not the selected default. Frame classification needs instrumentation; NotSet/Repeated can be Application in release output.
HAGS can reduce GPU execution timing accuracy. Vulkan/Other has less presentation instrumentation and weaker CPU pacing/latency attribution.

New engine/update with rendering work; native sandbox bot action recording/playback/loops and new replay camera/player-view controls. These are useful repeatability features, not a supplied FPS benchmark.

JasperP uses bot matches for performance testing, asks to distinguish bot/Explore NYC/live matches, and says Vulkan selection requires restart. HUD suppression is a diagnosis experiment, not a usable competitive profile.

sources.finding: Linux/13600KF/7900XTX author reports approximately 134 FPS versus 271 FPS with dense versus simple view; aggregate engine worker CPU time increases about 54%, Low versus Ultra changes little. Does not establish this Windows machine's bottleneck.

Updated Aug 27 2026; AL2 adds pacing before input polling and has an optional limiter. Test on/off separately; its software timing monitor does not measure full click-to-photon latency. Right Ctrl temporarily bypasses AL2; keep latency monitor off during throughput runs.

sources.verified: Live primary page checked2026-10-04: representative scenes, means/percentiles, sufficient tail samples and repeat variation. Under3% variation is AMD experience, not a universal significance gate. Cold-cache first-run tests are separate; no cache deletion between routine warm comparisons. GPU queue/idle diagnosis is stronger than aggregate CPU utilization.

presentMon.wallTime: At least approximately 70 seconds including 10-second lead-in; request foreground readiness for 80 seconds.
presentMon.noAdditionalComponents: Console executable alone; no MSI, persistent service, overlay, hook, DLL injection, game assets, launch flags or input automation needed.

statusRegex.final: Also parse final lost-event/lost-buffer/overflow warnings; record maximum seen count, never infer zero from absent output.

presentMon.noRowsPolicy: Absent CSV or no frame rows is an unsuccessful measurement regardless of exit code. Preserve log and metadata, completed=false; no computed FPS.
presentMon.escalationPolicy: No restart_as_admin, registry/security/group changes or session-killing flags. If ETW capture remains unavailable, preserve the limitation and use user-executed native summary as exploratory evidence.
presentMon.analysis: For 60-second observation: warmup 0, requested duration 60, default minimum 60 (250 ms endpoint allowance in analyzer). For 30-second observation, explicitly min-seconds 30, warmup 0 and label exploratory; the stricter wrapper presently does not support observation without assertions.

vprofLite.nativeFileHints: perfstats_ and CSV column hints: Run Time, Frame Time, Simulation, Sim Ticks, Single Tick, Server, Client, Render Wait, Present Wait, Render GPU; position fields.

experiments.title: Validate monitor, then observe current profile
experiments.controls: Verified current PID/lifetime and sampled foreground; all unverified scene/cache/FG/effective-setting fields remain unknown.
experiments.output: Actual application frametime stream, FPS/mean-tail 1%/p99/hitch distribution if ETW succeeds; baseline observation only.
experiments.userAction: Play selected current-patch replay at normal speed, keep game foreground; no profile switching yet.

experiments.title: Establish dense city and combat repeatability
experiments.interval: One dense-geometry interval and one later effect-heavy interval from same replay; do not average them together.
experiments.controls: Record replay identity/hash where available, exact start/end tick or replay time, one hero/player view, camera setting/FOV/HUD, speed 1, no pause/menu/tab transitions. Traverse interval twice before warm runs.
experiments.output: Repeat variation and scene sensitivity; quiet sandbox kept as separate diagnostic.
experiments.userAction: Choose view, scrub the same start time, play; confirm driver frame generation off and effective settings when available.

experiments.title: Installed aggressive versus exact original
experiments.change: Only the declared configuration comparison; baseline exact Oct 3 backup, candidate exact installed profile.
experiments.controls: Same renderer, replay/camera/ticks, cap, display, driver, background load and warmed assets; game closed and cloud complete for file installs.
experiments.design: One ABBA block for screening (not proof); promising result gets at least three independent ABBA/BAAB blocks. Existing comparer requires 12 captures.
experiments.output: Gains above repeat variation with mean-tail 1% and p99 guardrails; report readability separately.
experiments.userAction: Safe exit/restart and replay seek for each profile, or native menu changes if all required settings really apply live.

experiments.title: Resolution response before lower quality
experiments.controls: Fixed dense and combat intervals; no backend/Anti-Lag/texture changes combined. 60% is a supported menu candidate, not an asserted improvement.
experiments.interpretation: Strong FPS response with GPU busy evidence suggests pixel/GPU limit; near-zero response suggests caps or CPU/scene work. HAGS timing alone cannot diagnose. 60% of1080p is1152x648 and may hurt distant-target readability.
experiments.userAction: Native video scale change and same replay seek; visually compare motion/targets/effects.

experiments.title: Native Anti-Lag2 throughput versus latency
experiments.controls: Same effective uncapped FPS, renderer and scene; verify whether any AL2 limiter is wired by game. Keep its diagnostic monitor off for throughput.
experiments.interpretation: AL2 is pacing/latency technology; no guaranteed FPS boost or guaranteed off winner. Replay does not validate live input latency; software monitor not click-to-photon.
experiments.userAction: Menu change or deliberate SDK-documented temporary bypass for diagnosis, then explicit stable on/off state for repeated runs.

experiments.title: DX11 versus Vulkan
experiments.controls: Restart each backend; independently warm exact route; same video settings/AL2 state. Confirm actual loaded backend, not just stored checkbox. Revert on visual/stability regression.
experiments.interpretation: Measure on this Windows/RDNA3 system; Linux DXVK report does not predict winner. Vulkan CPU/GPU attribution less exact.
experiments.userAction: Select renderer in native menu, exit/restart, warm and repeat replay.

metricDefinitions.averageFps: 1000 divided by arithmetic mean of application intervals in milliseconds. Do not average per-frame FPS.
metricDefinitions.onePercentLow: 1000 divided by mean of slowest ceil(N*0.01) intervals; distinct from 1000/p99.
metricDefinitions.percentile: Linear interpolation at (N-1)*p over sorted intervals.
metricDefinitions.exclusions: Trim only prespecified lead-in/window boundaries. Keep genuine long frames. Never sum swapchains/processes or market generated frames as rendered FPS.
metricDefinitions.uncertainty: 30-60 seconds supports monitoring/screening; one scenario and one run establish no causal profile win. Comparable scene metadata is a declaration, not automatic proof.

satisfactory: Pinned official hash/source, scoped explicit download, no injection/game input, unique ETW session and output files, focus/lifetime checks, null missing counters, actual exit and log preservation.

Analyzer distinguishes frame-time definitions; rejects truncated/discontinuous/mixed streams, generated/unknown rows for comparison; null metadata counters produce unknown-warning rather than numeric parse failure.
Comparer uses independent ABBA blocks, source hashes and context/method checks; synthetic fixtures are rejected as evidence. No statistical confidence claim.

Concrete known runtime/scenario declarations now gate eligibility and are independently validated by comparator; unknown cap/camera/route stays exploratory even with stale quality flags. Native-scene and replay results are distinguished.

defectsAndLimitations.issue: Mandatory ForegroundConfirmed and SceneConfirmed are appropriate for controlled runs but force unsupported scene assertion for an uncontrolled autonomous observation.
defectsAndLimitations.recommendation: Root can use direct CLI with truthful null metadata now. If assigned, add explicit observation mode with foreground sampling and unknown scene/cache/FG state; never silently relax comparison checks.

defectsAndLimitations.issue: Wrapper permits at least30 effective seconds, while printed analyzer command defaults to60 minimum. Seconds60 with default warmup10 yields50 and refuses; Seconds30 with warmup10 is rejected outright.
defectsAndLimitations.recommendation: Require60 effective seconds for controlled comparison or explicitly print matched min-seconds for a clearly labeled short exploratory observation.
defectsAndLimitations.resolution: Printed analyzer command now includes --min-seconds=min(declared effective analysis window,60), retaining the script 30-second floor. Node test accepts a complete50-second stream while refusing an uncovered60-second request; PowerShell checks cover30/50/120-second windows.

defectsAndLimitations.issue: eligibleForComparison requires declarations/completion but not traceLossVerified. Unknown loss status can enter comparison despite strict quality objective.
defectsAndLimitations.recommendation: Require all3 counters knownzero for verified comparison, while retaining unknown/null exploratory analysis with warnings. Also reject negative CSV loss counters if that nonstandard schema is admitted.
defectsAndLimitations.resolution: Analyzer eligibility requires traceLossVerified; comparator independently requires it even if a stale report sets eligible=true. Null/missing status remains valid exploratory input. CSV counters must be nonnegative integers and all knownzero for verification.

defectsAndLimitations.issue: Collector process wait has no bounded watchdog; stalled timer/session may wait indefinitely.
defectsAndLimitations.recommendation: Bound wall time with generous grace and terminate only the wrapper-owned collector if needed; mark capture incomplete, preserve logs. Never stop the game or another session.
defectsAndLimitations.resolution: Deadline=delay+capture+30seconds; after expiry only returned collector instance may be killed, guarded by retained process handle, PID, creation time and pinned path. Cleanup wait is at most5seconds. Failure marks incomplete, preserves logs/metadata and retains original stdout/stderr if exit/read cannot be confirmed. No game/other-session termination.

defectsAndLimitations.issue: PID focus sampled500ms can miss brief switches, shader/FG assertions are declarations, effective game caps/renderAPI/menu state is not verified.
defectsAndLimitations.recommendation: Keep warnings and obtain runtime/native user confirmation before comparative claims.

defectsAndLimitations.issue: Old final overflow-warning pattern missed the official source wording overflowed present events, so a final nonzero count could be overlooked after earlier zero status.
defectsAndLimitations.resolution: Pure Get-CaptureEtwLossCounters helper matches actual pinned warning wording and legacy plural, takes maximum counts, and leaves absent status null. Offline tests prove final positive warnings override earlier zero lines for all3counters.

defectsAndLimitations.severity: Critical schema interpretation error caught before benchmark
defectsAndLimitations.issue: CPUStartTime incorrectly mapped to seconds despite actual pinned CLI output using milliseconds; original synthetic v2/default fixtures also used wrong units.
defectsAndLimitations.resolution: Analyzer1.1.1 maps known CLI CPUStartTime to milliseconds; wrapper explicitly records matching milliseconds and rejects conflicting inherited declarations. Both fixtures corrected. Synthetic30FPS unit test rejects wrong-seconds interpretation, and real foreground CSV passes continuity/coverage without relaxing comparison criteria.

defectsAndLimitations.issue: Only machine/build/driver/scenarioId were required; null cap/backend/output/camera or replay interval could previously survive matching context and yield a winner.
defectsAndLimitations.resolution: Analyzer1.2.0 requires known renderer/output/cap/camera/background plus replay identity and ordered integer ticks/positive speed, or native map/procedure/state. Comparer reruns requirements independently of stale eligible/contextComplete flags. Numeric cap0 is valid. Unknowns remain exploratory. Complete matched declarations do not automatically prove physical runtime readback or scene replication.

tests.limitation: Synthetic parser/comparison and offline PowerShell helper/AST checks. Actual2-second foreground CSV was also analyzed offline for units/interval continuity, not as benchmark evidence. Live watchdog termination has not been executed by this agent.

autonomousBoundary.feasibleNow: Prepare truthful capture metadata and exact CLI, inspect already-created raw logs/CSV, analyze offline, verify hashes/version/PID/lifetime and sample foreground without game input. Root alone coordinates/downloads/captures to avoid concurrent load.
autonomousBoundary.requiresSceneUser: Scene control is required for replay readiness, selected player/view/normal speed/start and repeated seek, avoiding menus/focus changes, warm traversal and readable-quality assessment. Root reports newer user authorization to operate native UI, so these controls need not require the user to physically operate every step; this research agent still performs no game control.
autonomousBoundary.requiresControlledChangeUser: Config/backend changes require coordinated game exit/restart/cloud completion or verified native menu application. Any authorized root UI/console control must be captured in metadata and performed outside an active match; this research agent does not perform it.
autonomousBoundary.performanceLimit: No research, static audit, empty smoke or synthetic test can establish 'best', a measured OptiLock win, 1000x gains, or full input latency.

comparisonContextContract.unknownPolicy: Missing/null/unknown/placeholder-like declarations remain valid exploratory analysis, comparisonContextComplete=false and eligibleForComparison=false. Comparer independently rejects them even if report quality flags are stale true.
comparisonContextContract.matching: Entire comparisonContext matches exactly across reports, as do frame-time method, timestamp units, warmup, duration and collector version. Actual backend interventions need a separate explicitly designed context policy; never misstate renderer to force a comparison.
comparisonContextContract.evidenceLimit: Structural completeness validates declarations, not automatic runtime readback, scene state, matched camera or identical background activity.
comparisonContextContract.output: consistentScenarioImprovement covers either type; legacy consistentReplayImprovement can be true only for replay scenarios.
comparisonContextContract.currentResult: Foreground359-interval1.945118s schema smoke proves collection/units only; no empirical configuration winner is established.
